summary: ITER146 HOTFIX · Core Module Safety™ — FULL VERIFICATION PASS. Backend: 24/24 PASS (11 new safety + 8 ITER146 lead pipeline + 1 ITER149 parity + 4 new ITER150 API-contract tests). Frontend: /admin/tenant-configuration renders the new defensive UI exactly per spec — CORE CRITICAL badges visible on the 6 canonical modules, the disabled/hidden/locked state pills are locked (data-locked=true, disabled attr, cursor=not-allowed, opacity=0.35), enabled/beta pills remain clickable, the Italian tooltip matches verbatim 'Modulo fondamentale per l'operatività runtime. Non può essere disattivato.', non-critical modules (crm_accounts etc.) have NO badge and freely togglable pills. Resolver auto-force fires for BOTH platform_feature_defaults=disabled AND tenant_configuration.feature_flags=hidden, with effective_state='enabled' and resolution_source='core_critical_force_enabled'.
